title: Films and books
about: Collocations for talking about films and books: how they come out, get reviewed and recommended, how films are cast, shot and starred in, and how we read — with phrases such as based on a true story, a box-office hit and an easy read.

parts.title: Just about books, audiobooks and e-books
Common mistakes
parts.note: Критики рецензують книжки й фільми — review, а не criticise: criticise означає «критикувати, казати погане» (The film was criticised for being too long). Телевізор дивляться — watch television (TV), не see television. А конкретний фільм чи передачу по телевізору можна і see, і watch: I saw / watched a great documentary on TV last night. Про кіно найчастіше кажуть see a film at the cinema.

rows: a critic / a recension of the film
see / watch a film on TV
сходити в кіно на новий фільм
see the new film at the cinema
at the finish of the film
at the end of the film

items.pattern: sth comes out (in May / next week) · come – came – come · more formal: be released
items.meaning: becomes available for people to buy, read or watch for the first time
items.example: The third book in the series **comes out** next month, and my daughter has already ordered it.
more: When the film **came out**, there were queues outside every cinema in town.
Her first novel **came out** when she was only twenty-two.
items.watchOut: «Вийшла книжка / вийшов фільм» — came out, не went out і не got out: go out — піти кудись, згаснути (про світло), а в британській англійській ще «вийти в ефір» про телепередачу (The show goes out at nine). Офіційніше — was released.

items.pattern: review a book / film / play · a reviewer
items.meaning: write or say what you think of a new book or film, usually for a newspaper, magazine or website
items.example: My cousin **reviews films** for a local radio station.
more: The magazine **reviews** three or four new novels every week.
Nobody has **reviewed** the play yet because it only opened last night.
items.watchOut: «Рецензувати» — review, а не criticise: criticise — критикувати, казати погане. Критик може й похвалити книжку, але він її все одно reviews. Не плутай з revise — переглядати, виправляти (або повторювати матеріал до іспиту).

items.pattern: a book reviewer · a film critic · critic (the person) ↔ criticism (what is said)
items.meaning: a person whose job is to read new books or watch new films and write about them
items.example: Most **film critics** loved it, but my friends found it boring.
more: She worked as a **book reviewer** for a Sunday newspaper for ten years.
Even the toughest **critics** said the last scene was perfect.
items.watchOut: Critic — це людина (критик), а не «критика». Критика — criticism, а рецензія — a review. Наголос на першому складі: /ˈkrɪtɪk/.

items.pattern: write / read a book / film review · a review of sth · get good / bad reviews
items.meaning: a piece of writing that says what someone thinks of a new book or film
items.example: I always read a few **film reviews** before I buy a cinema ticket.
more: She writes a **book review** for the school magazine every month.
Did you see the **review** of that new crime novel in today's paper?
items.watchOut: «Рецензія» — a review, не a critic (це людина) і не a recension (рідкісне слово про редакцію тексту). Revue — це естрадне шоу, а не рецензія. Відгук на сайті — теж a review.

items.pattern: give a book / film a bad / good / great review · get bad / good reviews
items.meaning: say in a review that a book or film is bad (or good)
items.uk: дати поганий (добрий) відгук, розгромити в рецензії
items.example: The critics **gave** the musical **a bad review**, but audiences loved it.
more: One newspaper **gave** her new novel **a terrible review**, and she was upset for weeks.
Her first album **got** brilliant **reviews**, but her second was a disaster.
items.watchOut: «Дати поганий відгук» — give it a bad review або write a bad review, не make / put a bad review. Про відгук на сайті кажуть ще leave a review.

items.pattern: a book / film (is) based on a true story / real events / a novel
items.meaning: uses events that really happened as the starting point for the story
items.uk: заснований на реальній історії, за реальними подіями
items.example: The film is **based on a true story** about a family who sailed around the world.
more: I cried even more when I found out the book was **based on a true story**.
Her latest film is **based on** a children's novel she loved as a girl.
items.watchOut: «За реальними подіями», «за романом» — based on…, з прийменником on: based on a true story, based on a novel. Не based at і не based by.

items.pattern: a book / film captures the atmosphere / mood / spirit of sth
items.meaning: shows very well what a place, time or situation felt like
items.example: The film really **captures the atmosphere** of a small seaside town in winter.
more: The book **captures the atmosphere** of a big family Christmas, noise and arguments included.
Few films **capture the atmosphere** of a hospital at night as well as this one.
items.watchOut: «Передати атмосферу» — capture (або convey) the atmosphere, не pass / transmit the atmosphere. Наголос на першому складі: /ˈætməsfɪə/, а не «атмосфЕра».

items.pattern: a book / film deals with sth (a topic, a problem, a period) · deal – dealt – dealt
items.meaning: is about a particular subject
items.example: The novel **deals with** the difficult relationship between a mother and her teenage son.
more: It's a funny film, but it **deals with** some serious topics, like loneliness and grief.
Her books often **deal with** life in big, noisy families.
items.watchOut: «Книжка про… / порушує тему…» — deals with sth, з прийменником with, не deals about. Простіше — is about. Минулий час — dealt /delt/.

items.pattern: the opening / closing scene(s) of a film · in the opening scene
items.meaning: the first or last parts of a film
items.example: In the **opening scene**, a little girl is waiting alone at a bus stop in the rain.
more: The **closing scenes** were filmed on a beach in Cornwall.
We arrived late and missed the **opening scenes**, so we didn't understand who the old man was.
items.watchOut: «Перша / остання сцена» — the opening / closing scene (або the first / final scene), не the starting scene і не the finishing scene.

items.pattern: the opening / closing chapter(s) of a book · in the closing chapters
items.meaning: the first or last parts of a book
items.example: The **opening chapters** are a bit slow, but don't give up: it gets much better.
more: I read the **closing chapter** twice because I couldn't believe how it ended.
In the **opening chapters**, we meet the family and their noisy neighbours.
items.watchOut: Розділ книжки — chapter /ˈtʃæptə/. Перші / останні розділи — the opening / closing chapters (або the first / last chapters), не the starting / finishing chapters.

items.phrase: the beginning / end of a book / film
items.pattern: at the beginning / end of a book / film · from beginning to end
items.meaning: the first or last part of the story
items.example: At the **beginning** of the book, the main character is a shy girl who never speaks in class.
more: I didn't understand the **end** of the film. Did they get married or not?
The **beginning** of the story is a bit confusing, but it soon makes sense.
items.watchOut: Про книжки й фільми зазвичай кажуть the beginning / the end. The finish тут не вживають (finish — фініш у перегонах); the start of the film у розмові трапляється, але the beginning звучить природніше. Не плутай the end (останні хвилини чи сторінки) і the ending (як закінчується сюжет): a happy ending.

items.pattern: the central / main characters (of a book / film) · a central character
items.meaning: the most important people in a story
items.example: The **central characters** are two old friends who meet again after thirty years.
more: Kids love the book because the **central character** is a clumsy but brave little dragon.
It's hard to enjoy a film when you don't care about the **central characters**.
items.watchOut: «Головні герої» — the central / main characters, а не the main heroes: hero — це герой у значенні «відважна людина» або позитивний головний персонаж. Персонаж — character; personage англійською зазвичай означає поважну, відому особу.

items.pattern: a book / film has a happy / sad ending
items.meaning: ends in a way that is good for the main characters
items.example: I'm not in the mood for anything sad tonight. Let's watch something with a **happy ending**.
more: Children's books usually **have a happy ending**.
Life doesn't always **have a happy ending**, but I like my films to.
items.watchOut: «Хепі-енд» англійською — a happy ending, не a happy end. Ending — як закінчується історія; the end — самі останні хвилини чи сторінки.

items.pattern: recommend a book / film (to sb) · a recommendation
items.meaning: tell someone that a book or film is good and that they should read or see it
items.example: A friend **recommended this book** to me, and I finished it in two days.
more: I'd **recommend** this film to anyone who has a big, crazy family.
The librarian **recommended** a few detective stories for my grandad.
items.watchOut: «Порадити фільм» — recommend a film, не advise a film: advise — радити людині щось зробити (I'd advise you to book early). Кому — recommend a book to sb; у розмові кажуть і Can you recommend me a book?

items.pattern: be / come highly recommended · I highly recommend it
items.meaning: praised by many people, so that others are strongly advised to read or see it
items.example: The new crime series is **highly recommended**, so I've added it to my list.
more: This café was **highly recommended** by our hotel, and it was excellent.
I **highly recommend** it if you like slow, quiet films.
items.watchOut: «Дуже рекомендую» — I highly recommend it, не I very recommend it: very не ставлять перед дієсловом і перед recommended. І саме highly, а не high.

items.pattern: go on the stage (= become an actor) · a career on the stage
items.meaning: become an actor, especially in the theatre
items.example: Her parents wanted her to be a lawyer, but she always dreamed of **going on the stage**.
more: Plenty of children want to **go on the stage**, but very few make a living from it.
My grandmother nearly **went on the stage**, but she married young and never did.
items.watchOut: Сцена в театрі як місце — the stage. Scene — сцена як епізод фільму чи п'єси (the opening scene) або місце події. Тож «піти на сцену» — go on the stage, не go on the scene.

items.pattern: on the big screen (= at the cinema) ↔ the small screen (= TV)
items.meaning: the cinema, as opposed to television or watching at home
items.example: Some films look amazing on **the big screen** but boring on a laptop.
more: After years on TV, she's finally making her first film for **the big screen**.
Her detective novels work better on **the small screen**, as a TV series.
items.watchOut: On the big screen — у кіно; the small screen — телебачення. Тут саме big, а не large: це сталий вираз, а не розмір екрана.

items.pattern: (amazing / impressive / cheap) special effects · usually plural
items.meaning: powerful visual effects in a film, often created using technology
items.example: The story is weak, but the **special effects** are amazing.
more: My son wants to work on **special effects** for big adventure films.
Old films used model ships and buckets of water for their **special effects**.
items.watchOut: Effect — іменник (ефект, результат); affect — дієслово «впливати». Тож special effects, не special affects.

items.pattern: play / have / get the male / female lead · the lead (role) · the leading role
items.meaning: the main male or female part in a film or play
items.example: They're still looking for someone to play **the male lead**.
more: She got **the female lead** in the school musical.
Who's playing **the lead** in the new costume drama?
items.watchOut: «Головна роль» — the lead (або the lead role, the leading role), не the head role і не the chief role. Lead тут вимовляється /liːd/, як «лід», а не /led/, як метал.

items.pattern: play the role / part of sb · play a role in sth (= be important)
items.meaning: act as a particular character in a film or play
items.example: In his new film he **plays the role of** a grumpy old taxi driver.
more: My little sister **played the part of** a sheep in the school play.
She'd love to **play the role of** a villain for once.
items.watchOut: «Грати роль» — play the role / part of, не make a role. Play a role in sth — переносно «відігравати роль, бути важливим»: Sleep plays an important role in your health.

items.pattern: take on / have / play a cameo role · make a cameo appearance
items.meaning: a small but special part in a film, often played by a famous person
items.example: A famous footballer **has a cameo role** in the film as a hotel waiter.
more: The writer of the books **took on a cameo role** as a man reading a newspaper on a bench.
Watch till the end: there's a funny **cameo** from a well-known TV chef.
items.watchOut: «Епізодична роль» знаменитості — a cameo role, не an episodic role. Вимова: /ˈkæmiəʊ/, з наголосом на першому складі.

items.pattern: give / put in an excellent / outstanding / brilliant performance
items.meaning: act or perform very well
items.example: The young actor **gave an excellent performance** as a lonely teenager.
more: Even though she had a cold, the singer **gave a brilliant performance**.
Everyone in the cast **gave an outstanding performance**, especially the children.
items.watchOut: «Чудово зіграв» — gave an excellent performance, не made / showed a performance. Performance тут — гра актора, виступ, а не «вистава» загалом.

items.pattern: be nominated for an Oscar / an award / a prize · a nomination
items.meaning: be put on the official list of people or films that may win a prize
items.example: The film **was nominated for** five **Oscars** but didn't win any.
more: Our local bakery **was nominated for an award** for the best bread in the region.
She's been **nominated for an Oscar** three times but has never won.
items.watchOut: «Номінувати на премію» — nominate for, не on і не to: nominated for an Oscar. Наголос на першому складі: /ˈnɒmɪneɪtɪd/.

items.pattern: a box-office hit / success ↔ a box-office flop · the box office
items.meaning: a film or show that is extremely successful and sells a lot of tickets
items.example: Nobody expected the little animated film to become **a box-office hit**.
more: The musical was **a box-office hit** in London and then moved to New York.
His last three films have all been **box-office hits**.
items.watchOut: «Касовий» — box-office, не cash: box office — каса театру чи кінотеатру. «Касовий провал» — a box-office flop.

items.pattern: play to full / packed houses · a full house
items.meaning: have every seat in the cinema or theatre filled at each show
items.uk: збирати повні зали, йти з аншлагом
items.example: The show **played to full houses** all summer, so they added extra dates.
more: We couldn't get tickets: it's been **a full house** every night this week.
Their little village theatre **plays to full houses** every Christmas.
items.watchOut: «Повний зал, аншлаг» — a full house, не a full hall. House тут — глядацька зала театру чи кіно разом із глядачами.

items.pattern: cast a film / a play · cast sb as sb · cast – cast – cast · the cast (= all the actors)
items.meaning: choose the actors for a film or play
items.example: It took the director over a year to **cast the film**.
more: They **cast** a completely unknown actor **as** the young king.
The whole **cast** came on stage at the end to thank the audience.
items.watchOut: Cast не змінюється: cast – cast – cast, не casted. «Його затвердили на роль» — he was cast as…

items.pattern: star in a film / series · a film starring sb
items.meaning: play one of the main parts in a film
items.uk: зніматися в головній ролі; грати головну роль у фільмі
items.example: She's **starred in** more than twenty films, but she still gets nervous on the first day.
more: The new comedy **stars** two brothers who used to be teachers.
He became famous after he **starred in** a TV series about a family of farmers.
items.watchOut: «Зніматися у фільмі» — star in / act in / appear in a film, не shoot in a film. Про людину be shot — «бути застреленим»; про фільм чи сцену be shot — «бути знятим» (The film was shot in Wales).

items.pattern: shoot a film / a scene / an advert · shoot – shot – shot · be shot on location
items.meaning: record a film with a camera
items.example: They **shot the film** in three weeks with a very small budget.
more: The wedding scenes were **shot** in a castle in Scotland.
We watched them **shooting** an advert in the high street this morning.
items.watchOut: «Знімати фільм» — shoot або film, не take a film і не remove a film. Make a film — створити фільм загалом (від ідеї до монтажу), а shoot — саме процес зйомок.

items.pattern: make / produce / direct a film · a film-maker
items.meaning: create a film, from the first idea to the finished product
items.example: My nephew **made a film** about our grandparents' village for a school project.
more: It's cheaper than ever to **make a film**: all you need is a phone and a few friends.
Who **made** this **film**? The camera work is beautiful.
items.watchOut: «Зняти фільм» — make a film, не take a film: take кажуть про фото (take a photo).

items.phrase: be engrossed / absorbed in a book
items.pattern: be / get engrossed / absorbed in a book / a film / your work
items.meaning: be so interested in a book that you do not notice anything else
items.example: Dad was so **engrossed in his book** that he burnt the toast.
more: The kids were completely **absorbed in** the film and didn't hear the doorbell.
She's **engrossed in** a history of the Vikings at the moment.
items.watchOut: Після engrossed / absorbed зазвичай in: engrossed in a book. Вимова engrossed — /ɪnˈɡrəʊst/: «-ed» не читається окремим складом, а ss звучить як [s].

items.pattern: be / make compulsive reading (no a) · a compulsive reader
items.meaning: so interesting that you cannot stop reading
items.uk: те, від чого неможливо відірватися; читається на одному диханні
items.example: Her diary of a year on a tiny Scottish island is **compulsive reading**.
more: The letters my grandad wrote from his travels are **compulsive reading**.
My mum is a **compulsive reader**: she even reads the back of the cereal box.
items.watchOut: Compulsive — «такий, що не можеш зупинитися». Не плутай з compulsory — «обов'язковий»: compulsory reading — те, що обов'язково прочитати за програмою. Артикль не потрібен: it's compulsive reading.

items.pattern: (good / perfect) bedtime reading · a bedtime story
items.meaning: something you read in bed before you go to sleep
items.example: I keep a book of poems by my bed: it's my favourite **bedtime reading**.
more: My **bedtime reading** at the moment is a book of short travel stories.
When I was little, my grandma's **bedtime stories** were the best part of the day.
items.watchOut: «Читання перед сном» — bedtime reading (або reading in bed), не sleeping reading. «Казка на ніч» — a bedtime story.

items.pattern: an easy / a good / a quick read (read is a noun here) · light reading
items.meaning: a book that is easy and pleasant to read
items.uk: легке чтиво; книжка, яка легко читається
items.example: I need **an easy read** for the beach, nothing too serious.
more: Short stories are **an easy read** on a busy commute.
The book explains how money works, and it's **an easy read** even if you hate maths.
items.watchOut: Read тут — іменник з артиклем: an easy read, не an easy reading. Ще кажуть light reading (без артикля): Magazines are good light reading.

items.phrase: download an audiobook / an e-book reader app
items.pattern: download an audiobook / an e-book / an app (onto your phone or tablet)
items.meaning: copy a book or an app from the internet onto your phone, tablet or computer
items.uk: завантажити аудіокнигу / застосунок для читання електронних книжок
items.example: I **downloaded an audiobook** for the long drive to my parents'.
more: Can you help me **download an e-book reader app** onto my new tablet?
My grandad has **downloaded** fifty **audiobooks**, but he only listens to detective stories.
items.watchOut: Українське «завантажити» — це і download, і upload. Download — з інтернету на свій пристрій; upload — навпаки, зі свого пристрою в інтернет (upload photos).

items.pattern: flick / skim through a book / magazine / report · also flip / leaf through
items.meaning: look through something quickly without reading it in detail
items.example: I **flicked through** a travel guide in the shop and decided to buy it.
more: She **skimmed through** the instructions and started building the wardrobe.
Just **skim through** the menu and choose something quickly. We haven't got much time.
items.watchOut: Не забувай through: flick through a book, skim through a report. Так само кажуть flip / leaf through. Skim — пробігти текст очима, щоб схопити головне. Не плутай з list — це «складати список», а не «гортати».

items.pattern: be beautifully / well / badly written · a beautifully written book
items.meaning: written in a very skilful and pleasant way
items.example: Her new novel is **beautifully written**, and every sentence feels carefully chosen.
more: My grandparents' love letters were so **beautifully written** that we keep them in a special box.
It's a **beautifully written** guide to the mountains, not just a list of walks.
items.watchOut: Перед written потрібен прислівник: beautifully / well written, не beautiful written і не good written.

warmup.uk: Її нова книжка вийде в березні.
warmup.explain: Вийти (про книжку, фільм) — come out. Go out — піти кудись або згаснути.

warmup.uk: Я прочитала в газеті рецензію на цей фільм.
warmup.q: I read a ___ of this film in the paper.
warmup.explain: Рецензія — a review. Critic — це людина, критик.

warmup.uk: Фільм чудово передає атмосферу Одеси 1920-х років.
warmup.q: The film really ___ the atmosphere of Odesa in the 1920s.
warmup.explain: Передати атмосферу — capture (або convey) the atmosphere.

warmup.q: I love films with a happy ___.
warmup.explain: Хепі-енд — a happy ending, не a happy end.
Порадити книжку чи фільм — recommend. Advise — радити людині щось зробити.

warmup.uk: Після школи вона хоче стати акторкою — піти на сцену.
warmup.q: After school she wants to go on the ___.
warmup.explain: Театральна сцена — the stage. Scene — епізод фільму чи п'єси.

warmup.q: This animated film is the ___ hit of the year.
warmup.explain: Касовий — box-office: box office — каса кінотеатру.

warmup.uk: Вона знялася в головних ролях у трьох фільмах.
warmup.explain: Зніматися в головній ролі — star in a film. Shoot — знімати камерою або стріляти.

A.q: She's a film ___, so she sees about five new films every week.
A.explain: Кінокритик — a film critic (людина). Criticism — критика, review — рецензія.

A.q: The book ___ with life in a small mountain village after the war.
A.explain: Книжка про щось — it deals with sth (або it's about sth). Speak і tell так не вживають.

A.q: The cartoon is based ___ an old Ukrainian folk tale.
A.explain: Заснований на чомусь, за мотивами — based on.

B.q: They need a tall actor with a deep voice for the male ___.
B.explain: Головна чоловіча роль — the male lead.

B.q: The director's mother appears for a few seconds as a woman feeding pigeons: it's a ___ role.
B.explain: Маленька, але особлива роль — a cameo role. «Епізодична роль» — не episodic role.

B.q: The actor who played the father was ___ for a BAFTA.
B.explain: Номінувати на премію — nominate for. Appoint — призначити на посаду.

C.q: Sorry, I didn't see you come in: I was ___ in my book.
C.explain: Поринути в книжку — be absorbed / engrossed in a book.

C.q: Comics are an easy ___ for kids who don't like long books.
C.explain: Легке чтиво — an easy read: read тут іменник з артиклем. Lecture — лекція.

C.q: Every month I ___ two or three audiobooks from the library's website.
C.explain: Завантажити з інтернету на свій пристрій — download; upload — навпаки.

practice.q: My favourite author has a new novel that ___ next week.
Her second cookbook ___ last spring and sold out in a month.

example.title: Friday at the cinema
example.uk:
Моя сестра кілька тижнів радила мені цей новий фільм, тож у п'ятницю ми нарешті пішли подивитися його на великому екрані. Він заснований на реальній історії про родину, яка тримала невеликий готель у горах під час війни.

Перша сцена, де сніг падає на порожнє село, чудово передає атмосферу тієї холодної зими. Акторка, яка виконує роль бабусі, грає просто блискуче, а режисер з'являється в епізодичній ролі листоноші.

Зал був повний, і ніхто жодного разу не глянув у телефон. Не розповідатиму, як усе закінчується, але кінець щасливий. Дуже рекомендую!
example.en:
My sister had been [[recommending|a14]] the new film for weeks, so on Friday we finally went to see it on [[the big screen|b2]]. It's [[based on a true story|a6]] about a family who ran a small hotel in the mountains during the war.

The [[opening scene|a9]], with snow falling on an empty village, really [[captures the atmosphere|a7]] of that cold winter. The actress who [[plays the role of|b5]] the grandmother [[gives an excellent performance|b7]], and the director has [[a cameo role|b6]] as a postman.

It was a [[full house|b10]], and nobody looked at their phone once. I won't tell you how it ends, but it does [[have a happy ending|a13]]. [[Highly recommended|a15]]!
